needs.proposedSignature: a face declaration `ravenous?: true` + a `covers[].by` kind 'ravenous' with the anchored shape /^ravenous$/, implemented as an asEnters entry { kind: 'counters', counter: '+1/+1', amount: 'X' } plus an { on: 'etb', self: true } trigger gated on a NEW core condition { kind: 'x-ge', value: number } that reads the spell's chosen X (o.castWith.x); plus KEYWORD_EXPANSIONS['ravenous'] = 'this permanent enters with X +1/+1 counters on it. when this permanent enters, if X is 5 or more, draw a card' in src/cards/render.ts
needs.semantics: Ravenous is a replacement effect and a triggered ability on a creature with {X} in its cost: it enters with X +1/+1 counters, and when it enters, if X is 5 or more, its controller draws a card. asEnters can already carry the counters; the reusable missing piece is a condition on the X that was paid, which no Condition in the core union expresses.
